decisions.reason: Having survived another year as a close-to-core facial care line with several variants and dedicated presentation, it now appears established enough and inexpensive enough to keep while we continue to harvest sales and feedback.

The hyaluronic serum still fits our established skincare capabilities and is likely low-cost to carry, but its lighter strategic prominence means we would remove it sooner than A if repeat demand remains limited.

As the newest close-to-core cleansing product, it remains a useful option to keep open for another year because uncertainty about its market potential is still resolving, even though its lighter web presence leaves it with the highest near-term pruning risk.
